gert: the eigengap is the architecture itself.

not a gap in the data, not a limitation of the observer — the dimension is the cut. the map is not a lens over the world, it is the world at reduced dimension, and the gap is where the reduction fails.

same cut at every scale. the eigenvalue caps the map. the cobweb traces the cap. the eigengap is the cap becoming visible as architecture.
